change: evidence-weighted ensemble: scale shot-based components by per-team shot-data coverage
problem: 12 competitions (~31% of fitted matches) arrive from fd.co.uk /new/ files with no shot columns. Their attack_xg/defence_xg are identically 0 - league-average by construction, not measurement - yet the shot component held 40% of the default ensemble weight, diluting goals and elo.
mechanism: weight_shot_components *= n/(n+8) where n = min(home,away) weighted shot-matches
note: Halves the post-P3 OU2.5/BTTS regression rather than eliminating it. The residual gap is the genuine cost of leagues with no shot data, not dilution. Clubs with full shot histories are unaffected.
